_comment: When to send WhatsApp reminders. Phone numbers are NOT here — they live in
the WHATSAPP_RECIPIENTS secret, because this repository is public and a
published number cannot be revoked the way a token can.
eventTypes: add "revision_requested" to be reminded about post-review
revisions as well as pre-review amendments.
remindAt: days remaining at which to send. null means 'when first seen'.
